name: Saigon Evening Cultural Tour with Water Puppets and Dinner Cruise
subtitle: A combined traditional Vietnamese water puppet show and Saigon River dinner cruise with evening city views and cuisine
description:
The Saigon Water Puppet & Saigon Cruise Dinner Experience in Ho Chi Minh City gives you a cultural evening that combines a traditional Vietnamese water puppet show with a relaxed dinner on the Saigon River. You will watch the water puppet performance, which presents a longstanding Vietnamese art form in a theatrical setting.

After the show, you will unwind on a luxury Saigon River dinner cruise. Along the way, you will enjoy delicious cuisine, take in beautiful night views of the city and relax in a calm, pleasant atmosphere. The evening blends cultural entertainment with river-side dining, offering a mix of tradition, food and city charm as you move from the theatre to the river.
highlights: Traditional Vietnamese water puppet show with classic folklore and puppetry artistry
Luxury Saigon River dinner cruise with delicious cuisine served onboard
Saigon River night views of illuminated skyline and riverside landmarks
Cultural and culinary evening combining a live show and river dining
included: Dinner on Saigon cruise (menu or buffet)

name: Hue to Dong Hoi by Private Car via Vinh Moc Tunnels
subtitle: Private car transfer Hue to Dong Hoi via La Vang Holy Land, Hien Luong Bridge, Vinh Moc Tunnels
description:
Có lựa chọn hủy miễn phí

Muộn nhất là 24 giờ trước thời gian bắt đầu

This private car service from Hue to Dong Hoi gives you a comfortable, scenic and historical way to travel between the two cities. You will ride in a private vehicle and move through Central Vietnam while taking in a journey that focuses on key local landmarks rather than just point-to-point transfer.

Along the way, you'll have time to explore La Vang Holy Land, visit Hien Luong Bridge, and see the legendary Vinh Moc Tunnels. As you move between these stops, you will experience a mix of religious significance, historic sites and wartime heritage that characterise this part of the country. The route is arranged so you can step out and spend time at each location before continuing on to Dong Hoi.
highlights: Private car transfer from Hue to Dong Hoi included
Route includes stops at La Vang Holy Land and Hien Luong Bridge
Scheduled stop at the legendary Vinh Moc Tunnels
